title: Electrical & Electronic Railway Systems

canonicalTerminology.definition: An electrical circuit is an interconnected path through which electrical energy or signals are transferred between sources, conductors and loads.

claims.text: Railway electrical and electronic systems include power, control, protection, sensing and communication functions with interfaces to the wider vehicle or infrastructure system.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

equations.limitation: Basic DC or instantaneous teaching relationship; AC and converter systems require appropriate power-factor, phase and waveform treatment.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show separation of power, control, protection and sensing paths.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent operational acceptance limits, tolerances, settings or manufacturer-specific values.
Do not present educational diagrams or summaries as approved operating or maintenance instructions.
